app.mode.heat.label: Heat
app.mode.heat.title: Additive heat: every visible row contributes a camera-facing radial ramp
app.mode.difference.label: Difference
app.mode.difference.title: Signed heat: one set of teams adds, the other subtracts
app.mode.teamHeat.label: Team heat
app.mode.teamHeat.title: Heat coloured by group: one hue per group, mixed where groups overlap, opacity still carrying density
app.mode.lineHeat.label: Lines
app.mode.lineHeat.title: Line heat: a line from each of a person's samples to their next, between the events that start and end a route, with the heat falling off sideways - where people went rather than where they stood
app.update.available: A newer version of 3DHeat is available ({count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}, the newest: {latest}).
app.update.restart: Updated. Its dependencies changed: close the server window and run restart.bat to finish.
app.update.restartConfig: Updated. Its server settings changed: close the server window and run restart.bat to finish.
app.update.current: Nothing to update: this copy is already the newest version.
app.update.dirty: This copy has local changes, so it is not updated automatically; commit or stash them, then run git pull.
app.update.diverged: This copy has commits of its own that the newest version does not; update it with git pull.
app.update.failed: The update did not go through: {reason}
app.appUpdate.autoHint: Downloads a new version in the background, checks its signature and installs it when you close the app. Off: the app asks first.

app.systemCheck.webgpuNoAdapter: WebGPU gave no graphics adapter: update the graphics driver
